title: KCF Model Readiness Report v1
description: One unified readiness verdict aggregating validity, coverage, pattern proof, and role resolution - so the self-check loop is one command, not four.

coverageStatus.description: A richer coverage verdict than the lone `ready` boolean: what kind of readiness holds.

readyFor.description: The downstream steps this model is ready for - currently codegen-handoff and review only. NOT a safety/deployment gate: `ready` does not imply security-review, deployment, or production readiness. Operational/deployment readiness is out of scope for KCF-OSS (see `deploymentReadiness`) and is evaluated by an external assurance overlay. See docs/CONCEPTS.md.

readinessLadder.description: Explicit MODEL-VALIDITY readiness rungs (derivable from the open toolchain) so `ready` is not misread as production-ready. KCF-OSS enumerates only model-validity rungs; operational/deployment readiness is out of scope (see `deploymentReadiness`) and its ladder is defined + evaluated by an external assurance overlay, not published here.

deploymentReadiness.description: KCF-OSS does not evaluate operational/deployment readiness (security review, data migration, deployment, production evidence) - that is an external assurance overlay's responsibility. Always 'not-evaluated-here', so `ready` is never mistaken for a deployment gate.

domainComplete.description: Always 'not-proven': coverage obligations are necessary, never sufficient, for real domain completeness - that is a human judgement, not a machine verdict.

behaviourallyComplete.description: A SEPARATE axis (never folded into `ready`): whether the behavioural half of the model is machine-realizable or will only scaffold. `not-proven` means present but not realizable as declared (opaque rule conditions / no action procedure / unresolved expression operands).
